items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: You know Peterson? Yes. He knew me well.

ctx.x: No, I guess not. I don't think it's published anymore. I tried to buy it and I couldn't.
Well, I tried. I bought my last book to teach my grandkid at, he know me good. You know Peterson? Yes. He knew me well. Yeah, Peterson. Broad Street.
Broad Street. What kind of a drum set did you have when you started? You had a full set?
